description: REEF3D::SEASTATE structures (A 725, Phase 6b): three obstacles across a channel (50 x 10 cells of 30 m, depth 20 m, zero-gradient sides): a rubble-mound breakwater after d'Angremond et al. (1996) with crest 0.5 m above the water level (type 1, Kr 0.1), Kt and Kr per frequency from seastate-obstacle-2.dat (type 2), and a porous breakwater per frequency (type 3, width 10 m, porosity 0.4, D50 0.5 m) with diffuse reflection (A 726). Validation in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/37_structures.
